title: Thi Karbala Mein Haq
body:
thi karbala mein haq ko zaroorat hussain ki
lagti watan mein kaise tabiyat hussain ki
<<DIVIDER>>
teeron ki chaon mein wo imamat hussain ki
ran me sipar bani hai jama'at hussain ki
thi karbala mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
hurr baar baar kehta tha dum todte hue
jee bhar ke kar saka na mai nusrat hussain ki
thi karbala mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
daaman chuda sake na sakina se shaahe deen
ruqsat ke waqt ghair thi haalat hussain ki
thi karbala mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein jab sakina ne baba ko di sada
tadpi tadap ke reh gayi mayyat hussain ki
thi karbala mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
aaya hai tumse qaid my milne sare hussain
utho sakina karlo ziyarat hussain ki
thi karbala mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
umme rabab saaye mein baithi na umr bhar
roti thi yaad karke musibat hussain ki
thi karbala mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
cheenega kaun tujhse zamane mein jeete ji
mehshar tera qalam hai amanat hussain ki
thi karbala mein…
author: Mehshar Lakhnavi
